rule:
The test-period read for a batch sweep -- by a rule written before looking, with no judgement in it.

From ``runs/<fid>/sweep_<tag>.json`` (train / valid only) it picks, mechanically:

* ``v_base`` (the original) and ``k_known`` (the known-family benchmark), always;
* the best variant of each of the 3 best KINDS (structure / leaf / memory / shape / neutral /
  hypothesis ...), ranked by pure-long Sharpe on the user's training period, among variants that
  pass the gates (cov >= 0.95, dist >= 0.5) and whose long leg is positive on BOTH train and valid;
* the two best candidates BUILT ON the known family (overlays, screens, or any hypothesis that contains
  it) -- reported apart, because they are the known family plus a tilt or minus a screen;
* ``k_known_xfrozen``, the generic screen (known family, never the frozen-quote names), as their benchmark.

Only these are scored on the holdout (the user's test period), in the user's convention: half-life fitted on
the user's training period, pure long book net of 15 bp.  The sign of the original and of the benchmarks is the
sign of their rank IC on the user's training period (the user's rule); a picked candidate keeps the sign it was
picked under (``sign_flip`` marks the rare weak signal whose rank IC changes sign once valid is added).  The read
is ledgered.

v_base.expr: mul(sub(div(day_last(Close), day_first(Open)), 1), abs_(sub(day_mean(in_sustain_stddev(is_gt(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume))), add(in_mean_full(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume)))), in_stddev_full(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume)))))), Ret, 5)), day_mean(in_sustain_stddev(is_lt(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume))), sub(in_mean_full(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume)))), in_stddev_full(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume)))))), Ret, 5)))))

k_known_xfrozen.why: 已知族 + 剔除近 15 日冻结盘口最重的 20%(通用筛子基准)

h3_cvx_xage.why: 剔掉上市最短的 20%:次新段(7.1%)CVX30 段内 +15.5% 但段等权 -28.7%、书还超配 +5.2% ⇒ 疑似倒贴。cross_age 不像 cross_valid_count 那样在窗口饱和,是这件事的正确度量

seg_lowliq_m.expr: cs_first_low40(neg(mul(sub(div(day_last(Close), day_first(Open)), 1), abs_(sub(day_mean(in_sustain_stddev(is_gt(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume))), add(in_mean_full(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume)))), in_stddev_full(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume)))))), Ret, 5)), day_mean(in_sustain_stddev(is_lt(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume))), sub(in_mean_full(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume)))), in_stddev_full(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume)))))), Ret, 5)))))), cross_mean(day_sum(Amt), 30))
seg_lowliq_m.why: 只在成交额最低 40% 的股票里按本因子选

mem_ema30.expr: cross_ema(mul(sub(div(day_last(Close), day_first(Open)), 1), abs_(sub(day_mean(in_sustain_stddev(is_gt(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume))), add(in_mean_full(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume)))), in_stddev_full(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume)))))), Ret, 5)), day_mean(in_sustain_stddev(is_lt(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume))), sub(in_mean_full(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume)))), in_stddev_full(sub(log(Volume), in_forward_valid_part(log(Volume)))))), Ret, 5))))), 30)

h3_ov_xfroz_cvx.why: 叠在更强的基准 k_known_xfrozen(+16.4/+23.2)上:冻结盘口段本因子段内 +22~+32% 而已知族 -10.9%,两者在那一段方向相反 ⇒ 先剔冻结再叠 CVX,两笔收益可能不冲突。注意 KKX 已是'高=好'方向,故 CVX 取 neg

h3_ov_xfroz_bkliq.why: 最强基准(k_known_xfrozen +16.4/+23.2,毛 +21.1)配最正交的伙伴(桶内 z,rho_k ~0.05):组合里唯一还有机会越过 +18.5% 的写法。KKX 已是'高=好'方向,故伙伴取 neg。这条若也输,best_on_known = 无 就可以彻底收口
